roster_group_notes: Demiurg commerce vessels share several traits: Ponderous (no Come to New Heading); heavily automated, starting each battle at a fixed Ld rather than rolling; an armoured 6+ prow; particle-collecting shields (immune to blast markers and celestial phenomena, and they collect any blast marker their base touches during movement into a per-ship pile); and, in two specific circumstances only, a higher victory-point value when destroyed (see Demiurg VP below). The Cutting Beam is a lance (15cm, Front): base Strength 1, +1 per blast marker the ship collected in its preceding movement phase, to a maximum of Strength 8 (shown as S1+). Demiurg attack craft are Fighters (ASF, 30cm), Bombers (BMR, 20cm), and Assault Boats (AB, 30cm).
